item.title: Running ClickHouse® in Production – Lessons Learned
item.description: When we chose ClickHouse® as our main data lake for analytics at Cato Networks, we envisioned it as a silver bullet solution for our data needs, promising effortless data ingestion and ready-to-query dashboards. However, the journey from that initial setup to our current, sophisticated data platform has been filled with trials and tribulations, alongside valuable lessons. We first used ClickHouse® as a black box magical persistence layer, simply feeding data points and querying ready-made GraphQL datasets.
